title: Anth.us-Papyrus: publish sitemaps at production's URLs (/sitemap-index.xml + /sitemap-0.xml)
description:
Live anth.us advertises <link rel="sitemap" href="/sitemap-index.xml"> and serves /sitemap-index.xml -> /sitemap-0.xml (gatsby-plugin-sitemap). The port writes /sitemap.xml only, so after cutover the URL registered in Search Console (and any crawler's cached one) would 404.

Minimal fix (YAGNI): emit the same files as production: /sitemap-index.xml (a sitemapindex pointing at /sitemap-0.xml) and /sitemap-0.xml (the urlset of canonical page URLs), match the live files' structure (check https://anth.us/sitemap-index.xml and sitemap-0.xml), and add <link rel="sitemap" type="application/xml" href="/sitemap-index.xml"> to every page's head as live does. Drop /sitemap.xml (or 301 it to /sitemap-index.xml, whichever is simpler). The origin follows the PPY-f1f0a8 switch (https://anth.us in production, the branch host when guarded). The production robots.txt Sitemap: line points at /sitemap-index.xml. Exclude 404 and redirect-only URLs; every listed URL must be a canonical 200 page. Assigned to the PPY-f1f0a8 agent since it owns robots.txt and origin in the same file.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done on feature/PPY-f1f0a8-env-staging-guards (code in c7b98f6 site_env.py; hooks b6030f9). Emits /sitemap-index.xml (sitemapindex -> <origin>/sitemap-0.xml) and /sitemap-0.xml (urlset with live's namespace declarations, 193 canonical URLs, no 404), drops /sitemap.xml, adds <link rel="sitemap" type="application/xml" href="/sitemap-index.xml"> to all 194 pages, production robots Sitemap: https://anth.us/sitemap-index.xml. Build asserts both files are valid XML, every <loc> maps to a file in dist, origin matches. bin/check-guards.py checks /sitemap-index.xml 200 + origin (live staging fails that check until redeployed). Note live lists 254 URLs vs 193 here (port has fewer tag/blog-category pages); not addressed (YAGNI).
